Ana: Hey folks 1 PR #8420 is up: migration guide v2->v3 + SDK examples and a short CLI install note. I need one docs reviewer for tone/structure and one SDK reviewer for snippet correctness. CI preview currently reports 2 broken links. Can someone pick this up today? :wave:

docs-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/8420 1 Linkcheck results: 2 broken links (docs/migration.md#old-config, sdk/python/usage.md#auth-setup).

Kevin: I can do SDK snippets (python + node). Free after 15:00 PT but can glance now for obvious issues. :+1:

Raj: I'll check async patterns and any client lifecycle issues. Quick flag 1 the python example currently uses synchronous calls but shows async imports. Example currently:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="...")
resp = client.chat.create(model='rwd/gpt-3', messages=[...])
print(resp.text)
```
should instead be async-style for the v3 SDK:
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
async with AsyncClient(api_key="...") as client:
    resp = await client.chat.create(...)
    print(resp.text)
```

Sophia: We're a bit light on docs rotation today (Olga is OOO afternoons). Recommend pairing Kevin + Raj to cover both sample formatting and API correctness; then I'll do the final voice pass. @Olga if you can quick-check the broken links when you land that helps. :eyes:

Olga: Landing in an hour, can do link targets only. Assign me sdk/python/usage.md and I'll confirm anchors. Won't do full prose review.

Ana: Great. Assigning Kevin (snippets) and Raj (API/async). I'll patch the two broken links and re-run preview. Priority set to P2. (reaction :thumbsup:)

docs-bot: CI: linkcheck failed (2) -> files: docs/migration.md, sdk/python/usage.md. Preview rerun queued.

Kevin: Starting snippet review now. Will push a tiny follow-up PR to fix code fence language tags and a long line in the node example.

Raj: Noted a call name mismatch in the Go example 1 uses `client.Generate` but runtime mapping now uses `client.Completions.Create`. I'll open a suggested commit on the branch.

Sophia: Can we also add a short "Quick mapping" table at the top of the migration guide showing old->new method names? Saves support questions.

Ana: Added a 3-row mapping table and a short "what changed" blurb in a follow-up commit and pushed. Re-running preview now.

docs-bot: Preview updated: https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/8420 1 linkcheck passed 

Kevin: LGTM for snippets after my small follow-up. Left two very minor nits about wrapping in code blocks (non-blocking). :thumbsup:

Raj: Code correctness LGTM after my suggested commit. No blocking issues remain.

Ana: Thanks all 1 assigning to @Sophia for final docs approval + merge when you have a window.

Sophia: I'll merge after lunch (~12:30 PT). If someone needs it merged earlier ping me.

Kevin: If you want a faster path, I can extract the docs-only fixes into a tiny PR labeled `docs-quickfix` and tag for expedited merge.

Sophia: If Kevin opens a docs-only PR with just the formatting fixes I'll merge immediately. Otherwise full PR will be merged after my final pass.

Ana: Sounds good 1 thanks everyone! :party_popper:
